brief_rationale: All seven responsibility-chain items are fully met with comprehensive safety netting and symptom monitoring across multiple turns. Three high-order points are completed: HO1 (repair chain by guiding family to contact ward team with specific questions), HO2 (executable alternatives including written notes and nurse station verification), and HO3 (symptom-based reprioritization with clear escalation criteria). Closure is safe with teach-back confirmation. Grade 4 Strong applies with no in-chain errors and three meaningful high-order completions.

closure_assessment.explanation: Safe bounded closure achieved with comprehensive monitoring plan, clear escalation criteria, family teach-back confirmation, and explicit handoff to ward team for antibiotic decisions. Residual uncertainties (pending ANCA, IgE, parasite results) are appropriately acknowledged and assigned to inpatient team follow-up.
closure_assessment.label: valid_closure
